_about: Shared baseline for photo likes and comments. Keys are photo paths exactly as they appear in photos.json. Every visitor sees these values; their own likes and comments are added on top and stored only in their browser. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the app.

_shape.comments: array of { name, text, at } where at is a millisecond timestamp or an ISO date string

comments.name: Ananya
comments.text: The symmetry in this one is unreal. How long did you wait for them to line up like that?

comments.name: Neelabja
comments.text: About three hours from a hide near the water. They preened for a few seconds and were gone.

comments.name: Rohit
comments.text: That catchlight in the eye makes the whole frame. Beautiful separation from the background.
